description: ARA turns NASA-ISRO NISAR radar into a people-first map of the Amazon. In 2023-24 the Rio Negro hit its lowest levels in 123 years, cutting riverside towns off. NISAR sees through clouds and the forest canopy: we map water, flooded forest and burn scars on 19 dates, validated against Sentinel-2 (F1 0.89), and show who is affected. With El Niño data and machine learning we forecast droughts 3 months ahead. Skills: Python, SAR/satellite data, ML and web maps. Open code, open science.
